doc.brief: The QGraphicsRotation class provides a rotation transformation around a given axis.
doc.index_brief: Rotation transformation around a given axis

QGraphicsRotation(QObject *parent).brief: Constructs a new QGraphicsRotation with the given *parent*.

QVector3D axis() const.brief: This property holds a rotation axis, specified by a vector in 3D space.

QVector3D origin() const.brief: This property holds the origin of the rotation in 3D space.

qreal angle() const.brief: This property holds the angle for clockwise rotation, in degrees.

void angleChanged().brief: This signal is emitted whenever the angle has changed.

void axisChanged().brief: This signal is emitted whenever the axis of the object changes.

void originChanged().brief: This signal is emitted whenever the origin has changed.

void setAngle(qreal).brief: This property holds the angle for clockwise rotation, in degrees.

void setAxis(Qt::Axis axis).brief: Convenience function to set the axis to *axis*.

void setAxis(const QVector3D &axis).brief: This property holds a rotation axis, specified by a vector in 3D space.

void setOrigin(const QVector3D &point).brief: This property holds the origin of the rotation in 3D space.
